intuition: After trimming trailing spaces, the last word is the final contiguous run of non-space characters.

brute_force.approach: Split the string on whitespace and return the length of the final token.

optimal.approach: Scan backward over trailing spaces, then count characters until the preceding space or beginning.

edge_cases: The input may have leading or trailing spaces.
The string contains at least one word.
A one-word string returns its full length.
